name: ade_benchmark_with_llm_reason
description: A dataset/benchmark intended to evaluate large language models on ADE-related information extraction and reasoning tasks, where models must identify adverse drug events and provide chain-of-thought style explanations. It measures both extraction correctness and the quality of model-generated reasoning supporting extractions. Typically used to compare LLMs' factual extraction and explanation alignment in a medical/pharmacovigilance context.
evaluation_method: F1 / accuracy with supplementary human_eval for reasoning quality
reputation: Niche dataset on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for LLM evaluation in medical ADE extraction and reasoning.
